Today the atc_source signal rides only on the add_to_cart event, so we can see adds by source (pdp / collection-quickadd / upcart-upsell / cart / collection / other) but NOT which source actually drives purchases, revenue, or contribution margin. RECOMMENDED PATH (B): ThemeSmith stamps the source as a Shopify cart line-item property (_atc_source) at add-to-cart time; it persists through checkout natively and lands on the order line item; DataOps extends ingest_shopify.py to pull line-item customAttributes into raw_line_items as a first-class column; conversion-by-source becomes a clean SQL join against units sold / revenue / True Gross / margin that the pipeline already computes. This lands the source signal where the money is and joins to existing profit metrics, unlike the GA4-native alternative (Path A: item_list_name through to purchase) which is lossy and siloed in GA4 with no margin join. Live-cart instrumentation requires Justin sign-off before shipping.

projects.name: SEO Growth Program (Organic Search)
projects.description: Turn Teeccino's strong-but-under-clicked organic search position into measurable, revenue-weighted growth. Core insight from the 2026-06-10 GSC baseline: this is a CLICK problem, not a ranking problem â€” 93.5% of impressions already sit in the top 10, but site CTR is just 1.21% because a large share of impressions come from informational/definitional queries (the carob cluster alone is ~30% of impressions at ~0.47% CTR, SERP-suppressed by knowledge panels). Per Justin's 2026-06-10 decision, the program optimizes REVENUE-FIRST: commercial-intent queries on product/collection pages are prioritized over high-volume informational traffic. SearchSmith owns the outcome and routes the writes â€” title/meta + copy via CatalogSmith, on-page/schema/internal-links/CWV via ThemeSmith â€” then verifies each fix in GSC. Success is measured by per-fix CTR lift in the dashboard improvement ledger (clean causal attribution) and growth in commercial-query clicks (revenue proxy), not raw total clicks. Realistic 90-day target: +300-800 organic clicks/mo (+8% to +20% on a 3,927/mo base); the naive backlog figure (+1,948 at 3% CTR) is explicitly rejected as folklore because the carob SERP won't pay 3%.

incidents.title: Phantom-cleanup batch renamed SKUs on 19+ active free-item / GWP / donation / gift-box products
incidents.summary: Bulk SKU rename batch of 79 SKUs across 35 "phantom" products treated status=archived/draft/unlisted as phantom-eligible. Live BXGY discounts, FOTM Free Packet flow, Stay.ai bundles, donation upsell, and ~19 active free-item / GWP / Mystery Gift / gift-box products broke. Justin caught it on the live site ~90 min after the run; Shopkeeper reverted all 79 SKUs in 30 min, 0 failures.
incidents.rootCause: AgentSmith dispatched the cleanup with insufficient safety thinking. CatalogSmith's phantom signal (duplicate-SKU + non-active-status) inverts reality at Teeccino, where status=archived/draft/unlisted is the canonical hidden-but-active state for cart-addable products. Single safety guard (skip status=active) caught 48/83 entries; the remaining 35 included ~19 active products. Free Java Packet 7976160755960 — explicitly named in Shopkeeper CLAUDE.md as the FOTM Free Packet — got renamed despite being a hard-rule ID, because the hard-rule was in markdown text, not in a machine-readable refuse-list.
